game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the knight must hold off shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while shadow scouts close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while shadow scouts close in. Then check score and advance.
player_objective: Protect the signal beacon from shadow scouts in Watchtower Ring: keep score above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 6, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
